title: Participant identification

statement.en: Every participant must be identified before admission, using a verifiable identifier appropriate to its participant type, and must meet the minimum level of identity assurance required for its intended role. Identification establishes the participant as a trusted actor in the data space; access rights follow from, and are proportionate to, the assurance level achieved.

control: The operator performs identity verification under the oversight of the governance authority

expressions.note: Registered identifiers (business registry, VAT, LEI, EORI) checked by the operator against official registries. DSSC records this case as E0.
Automatic identity verification with wallet-based identities (eIDAS 2.0); credential ontology and trusted issuer list.

source: iSHARE Trust Framework (identification separate from authorisation)
